notes:
Summary: Enterprise legal archiving + discovery vendor. Primary focus: embeddings + reranking pipeline for internal e-discovery and compliance audits. They ingest long-form legal documents, court filings, and client contracts. Target scale: initially 35M pages (10M canonical docs for POC), long-term 100M+ documents. Current infra: Azure tenant with strict VNet controls, Okta SSO, internal vector store prototype causing cost spikes. Requirements: VPC/private deployment, KMS/HSM for key management, immutable audit logs retained 7 years, configurable retention policies and redaction workflows. Performance targets: retrieval+rerank P95 <300ms for K=10 rerank; tail latency for single-question path (retrieve top5 + cross-encoder rerank) <250ms preferred; embedding latency (online/upsert) <200ms. Cost goals: <$0.03 per user query at 50k q/day with batching/caching; open to dedicated reserved capacity if unit economics fit. Model preferences: lightweight embedding encoder + cross-encoder reranker (they will experiment with open LLM encoders and a small cross-encoder for reranking). Need support for hybrid search (BM25 + vector) and prefix/KV caching to reduce repeated query cost. Security/compliance notes: SOC2 required, ISO27001 preferred, retention controls + legal hold support mandatory. Data residency: US only for certain clients; ability to pin regions. Onboarding timeline: POC kickoff 2026-02-01.
Activities timeline:
- 2025-11-04: inbound lead via content download (RAG benchmark). AE intro call 11/10.
- 2025-12-03: demo of hosted/optimize features; security intro with Dir InfoSec scheduled.

- 2026-02-18: architecture workshop (Fireflies ff_2026_02_18_8723). Agreed POC scope: ingest 10M doc slice, test retrieval+rerank, measure latency & cost per query at 1k/10k/50k q/day simulations.
- 2026-02-25: SE delivered config suggestion: batching 64, kv cache TTL 12h, quantized model recommendation for reranker to reduce GPU cost.
POC milestones: 1) ingest sample (week 1), 2) run baseline retrieval (BM25 + vector hybrid) and compute metrics, 3) introduce cross-encoder reranker and measure delta in precision@5 and latency, 4) tune batching/caching with Redwood Optimize suggestions, 5) security signoff and deployment to VPC.
